query: SELECT o.tenant_id, o.id FROM namespaces AS n JOIN generation_operations AS o ON (o.tenant_id, o.namespace_id) = (n.tenant_id, n.id) WHERE n.state = 'deleted' AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_operations AS u WHERE u.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND u.namespace_id = n.id AND u.finished_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observations AS x WHERE x.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND x.generation_operation_id = o.id) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
